committed 7c8d094 (components/modules/ProjectilesScene.tsx only) - fixed user-reported "turning on air drag makes the balls oscillate in 1 point". FIX: replaced the raw force with the exact closed-form decay lib/physics/projectiles.ts already derives for this exact drag model (tau = mass_kg/dragK, v(t) = v0*exp(-t/tau)), applied directly to linear velocity via body.setLinvel scaled by useFrame's real delta each frame. exp(-x) is in (0,1] for any x>=0, so it is unconditionally stable regardless of dragK/mass/delta size - no k/m/dt combination can make it overshoot or flip sign. Gravity untouched (Rapier's own solver still integrates that separately each physics step, same as before). npx tsc --noEmit clean.
